faq.subtitle: [pl] Answers for multilingual SignalBoost SaaS operations.
faq.question.0: [pl] How does SignalBoost choose a language?
faq.answer.0: [pl] SignalBoost uses the saved cookie, saved browser preference, browser locale, and English fallback.
faq.answer.1: [pl] Yes. The dashboard language switcher persists the selected locale in a cookie.
